decisions.formulation: single_unit across Humalog Mix 50/50 U-100 and Humalog Mix 75/25 U-100 because both are fixed insulin lispro protamine/insulin lispro premixes and the compared perioperative guidance applies to premixed insulin without distinguishing the mixture ratio
decisions.conflict: Austrian Diabetes Association recommends converting mixed insulin to long-acting insulin at about two-thirds of the original mixed-insulin standard dose for routine operations, while the Brazilian anesthesiology society review recommends separating premix into intermediate and fast components and reducing the intermediate morning component by 25–50%; preserve both
decisions.after_procedure: no sufficiently specific primary-society restart instruction for fixed lispro premix was identified; do not infer one from class-level eating guidance
